dateline: Stanford, CA — World Cup Final Halftime Show confirmed with Madonna & Shakira; Stanford Stadium debut tomorrow; SWIM No. 1 Global Excl. US
heroHeadline: Day 4,719: BTS Confirmed for 2026 FIFA World Cup Final Halftime Show with Madonna & Shakira
heroSubtitle: May 15, 2026 is Day 4,719 since BTS's June 13, 2013 debut. On May 14, FIFA officially confirmed BTS, Madonna, and Shakira as co-headliners for the first-ever halftime show at the 2026 FIFA World Cup Final — July 19 at MetLife Stadium, East Rutherford, NJ — a performance curated by Global Citizen to raise $100 million for the FIFA Global Citizen Education Fund. HYBE's stock surged 7.2% on the Korea Exchange following the announcement, its largest single-session gain of 2026. Meanwhile, BTS is in Stanford, California ahead of three sold-out shows at Stanford Stadium (May 16, 17, and 19), where they will become only the second musical act ever to perform at the 50,000-capacity venue after Coldplay. Official ARIRANG World Tour merchandise went on sale on campus today. The Billboard Global charts (May 16-dated) confirm 'SWIM' holds at No. 1 on Global (Excl. US) and No. 2 on the Global 200. After Stanford, the ARIRANG World Tour — projected to gross approximately $1.8 billion across 79 shows in 34 regions — advances to Allegiant Stadium in Las Vegas for four nights (May 23, 24, 27, 28) alongside the 'BTS: The City Arirang' citywide festival (May 20–31 on the Las Vegas Strip).
